posts.text:
More than 4,000 South Carolinians are living with sickle cell disease.

South Carolina opted into the Cell and Gene Therapy Access Model, a federal initiative helping state Medicaid programs cover life-changing gene therapies which can cost millions of dollars.

MUSC in Charleston now serves as South Carolina's authorized treatment center for these therapies, with roughly 400 Medicaid members who may clinically qualify.

Make America Healthy Again starts at home.
